coverImageAlt: A faceless wooden steward arranges blank cyan-edged plan pieces around a small architectural model.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A thoughtful product steward coordinating separate blueprint fragments into one coherent architectural model, expressing an agent that drafts, critiques, coaches, and improves product requirements.
Scene/backdrop: Calm warm-paper design studio on a slate ground, with no walls of diagrams, no screens, and no visible writing.
Subject: One simplified, faceless slate-and-navy artisan figure at a broad worktable, arranging large blank cyan-edged plan pieces around a small assembled product model; one orange piece marks the unresolved decision under consideration.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; carved wood figure, thick paper plans, and handmade architectural maquette.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; centered steward and table create one readable silhouette; plan pieces are broad and sparse; crop-safe focal subject; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; gentle studio backlight with cyan edges and one sparing orange accent.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: warm carved wood, matte paper, book cloth, clay model surfaces, subtle tool-worn edges.
Constraints: original image; one dominant metaphor; the figure must be faceless and the plan pieces completely blank; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: corporate presentation scene, computer displays, humanoid robot, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, busy office clutter, recognizable branded products.
Targeted correction: Pull the camera back enough that the full worktable arrangement, every plan piece, the steward, and the product model sit inside the inner 84% of the frame with a visible uncluttered border on all sides; preserve the same faceless steward, blank interlocking plans, and handcrafted text-free metaphor.
